statements.statement: An unspent one-year $5,000 seed allocation for the 300th anniversary committee lapsed at fiscal year end and became free cash.
The 300th anniversary committee wants a new multi-year appropriation of $15,000 plus a separate gift fund, likely as two warrant articles at the next town meeting.
The principal assessor presented an assessors' department budget described as roughly a 6 to 7% increase overall.
